mapper.select: SELECT b.id, b.title, b.content, b.author_id, u.username as author_name, u.avatar_url as author_avatar, b.category, b.series_id, s.name as series_name, b.view_count, b.scheduled_at, b.status, b.created_at, b.updated_at FROM blogs b LEFT JOIN users u ON b.author_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN series s ON b.series_id = s.id WHERE b.id = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO blogs (title, content, author_id, category, series_id, scheduled_at, status, view_count, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{authorId}, #{category}, #{seriesId}, #{scheduledAt}, #{status}, 0, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE blogs SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT b.id, b.title, b.content, b.author_id, u.username as author_name, u.avatar_url as author_avatar, b.category, b.series_id, s.name as series_name, b.view_count, b.scheduled_at, b.status, b.created_at, b.updated_at FROM blogs b LEFT JOIN users u ON b.author_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN series s ON b.series_id = s.id WHERE b.status = 0 AND b.scheduled_at IS NOT NULL AND b.scheduled_at <= #{now} LIMIT 50
mapper.update: UPDATE blogs SET status = 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
